go_check.rule: M0 pass AND both scenes at lag16 every non-degenerate group has kappa CI upper bound <= 3/7 AND cost feasible

preregistered_evaluation.note: kappa criterion only; cost feasibility is evaluated in the cost profile and the final verdict

m1_gradient_variance.preconditioned_kappa_note: auxiliary diagnostic under the CURRENT snapshot Adam v metric (detached, eps=1e-15, zero-v elements dominate; see precond_*_curv_b32.json v_source); NOT the pre-registered metric

m1_gradient_variance.remedy_verdict: FAIL: means remains above 3/7 in both scenes (bicycle 0.4750, garden 0.5306); per section 3 the candidate is ended

cost.reading: 5K states pass even the conservative bound; 14K states fail even the optimistic bound because the coarse branch (c) grows with scene size; the sparse-kernel overhead that would realize any margin has no measured path inside the frozen binary -> cost side is INCONCLUSIVE_COST with a DROP_COST reading at 14K
cost.labels: same-machine strong-baseline replay step as unit (shared A100); component medians over >=30 CUDA-event samples; eta=1.2 HYPOTHESIS

final_rationale: M0 PASS: correctness verified; every first-pass excess attributed to the quaternion input convention or gsplat backward nondeterminism, and resolved within measured floors.

M1 main config q=1/4 fails the pre-registered kappa criterion in BOTH scenes: means and quats have kappa CI lower bounds above 3/7 at lag16 (bicycle means 0.864, quats 0.790; garden means 0.740, quats 0.560), so anchored p=1/8 is decisively worse than plain p=1/4 in the dominant energy groups.

The lag-0 diagnostic (no cache staleness at all) shows the same failure (bicycle means 0.844-0.880, garden means 0.730-0.807) -> the proxy Jacobian itself is insufficient; this is not a cache-lifetime problem.
The single allowed remedy (q=1/2) also fails: means kappa 0.4750 (bicycle) and 0.5306 (garden) remain above 3/7, garden quats 0.5848 also above.

The pre-registered DROP fast-track trigger (kappa>=1) did NOT fire; the verdict rests on the GO criterion failing decisively, the failed remedy, and the cost gate failing at 14K. Per DSH_EXECUTION.md section 3 the candidate is ended (no new proxies, no hyperparameter search, no sampling-strategy search).
residual_uncertainty: kappa is a sampled-block (32/camera) energy-ratio estimate, not a full-image exact value.
eta=1.2, delta*d, zeta, and the raster share of the fine fwd/bwd are HYPOTHESIS; the r interval [0, f_hi*fine_share] brackets the unobservable raster share.
Preconditioned kappa differs between scenes (garden much lower) but is dominated by zero-v elements and is not the pre-registered metric.
garden quats in the q=1/2 remedy is the only group that got worse relative to q=1/4; the remedy conclusion does not depend on it (means fails in both scenes).
